subject_line: An Author Spotlight for The Swiss Enigma
email_body:
Hi Cathy,

I came across your Sisterhood Sleuths series, an eight-book global mystery adventure for teens that weaves secret societies, codes, and hidden history together with life skills and moral lessons. The Swiss Enigma, the third book, takes that sleuthing across the Alps, and the Upland, California setting of the opening book gives the series a lovely sense of place.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for The Swiss Enigma is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Swiss Enigma best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
